title: Trump JUST *Launched* the GREAT Wealth Transfer
speaker: Kevin Paffrath (Meet Kevin)

macro_themes.view: War costs, tanker insurance, fuel, power and mortgage rates are paid by everyday taxpayers while stock owners (top 10%) benefit; K-shaped economy.
Calls ~5.27% as peak 10y yield; expects yields to fall, eventually more than ever, which would push stocks and home values higher.
Get on the 'Train America' ride by owning US stocks (even SPY), quality real estate and businesses; politics won't stop it.
Even a Democratic sweep changes little for two years; would favour green energy.

calls.condition: Best case if an Iran deal comes and yields prove they peaked.
calls.reason: Believes yields are near a peak around 5.27% and down from here; long run expects yields to come down a lot.
calls.quote: That's my peak call around 5.27. I think it's down from here.

calls.reason: Fiscal/war spending, 100% expensing and eventually lower yields keep inflating stocks ('Train America is going up').
calls.quote: if yields go down and oil keeps going down and mortgage rates come down, guess what happens? Stocks are just going to go up even …
